_comment: Voice catalog. NO model weights live in this repository; `model` is a file name inside PIPER_VOICES_DIR. Both voices below are fine-tuned from the Lessac voice, so their commercial status is unresolved: see README 'Licensing caveats'. Speaker ids on the multi-speaker English model were chosen by MEASURED median pitch (scripts/lab/voice-audition.ts: 300=115 Hz, 25=149 Hz, 400=92 Hz, 60=227 Hz) so the voices are distinct; nobody has listened to them yet.
